{{Quote|Our blasters just weren't bringing the voritor down. They're notorious for incredibly tough hides.|[[Dusque Mistflier]], to [[Finn Darktrin]]|<ref name="TRoD" />}}
A '''voritor lizard''' was an aggressive, venomous [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature commonly found on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

==Description==
{{Quote|In fact, no one is even sure how long these creatures live. It could be hundreds, maybe even thousands of years.|Dusque Mistflier, to Finn Darktrin|<ref name="TRoD" />}}
The voritor lizard was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] species native to Dantooine,<ref name="SWGTCG" /> although it could also be found on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="BoS" />

The average voritor was two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long,<ref name="TRoD" /> with a fan-like dorsal spike.<ref name="SWG" /> The beast was a solitary hunter of the plains of Dantooine that moved slowly until they come in for the kill.<ref name="SWG:V" /> When one decided to attack, it charged its target with incredible speed.<ref name="TRoD" /> [[Bol]]s were its favorite preys.<ref name="SWG:B">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Bol|Dantooine}}</ref> The voritor lizard was a venomous predator<ref name="SWG:V" /> with tough hide resistant to [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots.<ref name="TRoD" />

A race of voritor lizard, horned voritor, had pointed scales protecting its [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Ear/Legends|ears]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

==History==
{{Quote|You could have gotten us killed.''"<br />"''What? I thought the lizard was about to do that for sure.|Dusque Mistflier and Finn Darktrin|<ref name="TRoD" />}}
[[File:Sister_of_the_Voritor.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Sister of the Voritor]] with her pet.]]
On Dathomir, wild voritors were tamed by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]]. Those [[Sister of the Voritor|Sisters of the Voritor]] used the beasts to guard the borders of the Nightsister territory.<ref name="BoS" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Dusque Mistflier]] and [[Finn Darktrin]] were attacked by a voritor lizard on Dantooine. Dusque was forced to use a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] to kill the beast to save her life.<ref name="TRoD" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Qakkee]] tasked a spacer to kill six voritor lizards on Dantooine and brought him back their horns.<ref name="SWG:Tgh">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=general|The great hunter, phase III|Tatooine}}</ref> Around the same time, the collector [[Jener Mich]] tasked a group of spacers to hunt and kill an unreasonable number of voritor lizards on Dantooine.<ref name="SWG:VK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Voritor Killer}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Voritor_lizard_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Voritor lizards appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

In ''Star Wars Galaxies'', all voritor variants, including the horned voritor, were exclusively present on the planet Dantooine.<ref name="SWG" /> However, the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' incorrectly stated that the horned voritor was native to Dathomir.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The presence of voritor lizards on Dathomir was later validated in the reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="BoS" />
